name: print-social-carousel-photo-bracket-job-opportunities-multicolor
title: Multicolor recolored carousel with bracket-framed phone photos
whatItIs: The same twelve-tile carousel (phone-in-hand photos plus text tiles framed by corner brackets and a small logo) repeated across many different background color combinations from teal to orange to purple.
whatItMeans: Showing one layout re-skinned in a dozen color combinations demonstrates a template's flexibility and lets a brand pick a palette without redesigning the structure.
techniques: frame a photo with four corner brackets instead of a full border for a 'viewfinder' feel
design one fixed layout, then swap only background/accent color to generate a whole palette family
repeat a small dot-grid icon consistently as a structural motif across every color variant
bestFor: template packs sold with multiple color options

vocabulary.definition: four L-shaped marks at an image's corners suggesting a frame without fully enclosing it, evoking a camera viewfinder
